system.description:
The duelling knight of the Eltor and Holfast tourneys, who wins renown one opponent at a time.

  • Tourney Blade (1st): you gain Honour Attack at 1st level, using half your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) until 6th, when it uses your full modifier.
  • Tourney Renown (1st): Advantage on Charisma checks with nobles and knights who follow the tourneys, and a knight or noble who refuses your formal challenge to a duel loses face.
  • Twice Challenged (5th): you may Challenge twice per encounter, on different foes.
  • Champion's Blow (10th): once per encounter, your first hit on your Challenged foe doubles the weapon's damage dice (flat modifiers are not doubled). From 17th, twice per encounter.
